text: Brand stories have a variety of themes and vary greatly in content, but the underdog story is one of the most popular, and the theme is prominent in collective fantasy and consciousness ( Goldschmied et al., 2017 ). An underdog is a person or group who has a disadvantageous status in competition but makes arduous efforts ( Paharia et al., 2011 ). The opposite of the underdog is the top dog, who is in an advantageous position in competition. Paharia et al. (2011) confirmed that the underdog brand story is more able to arouse consumer sympathy than the top dog brand story, thus positively affecting consumer response to the brand.
source_label: Underdog or Top Dog Brand Story? The Role of Self-Construal and Need of Uniqueness
